function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search

messages.content: What was the admission diagnosis for this patient?
Admission diagnosis: Alcoholic cirrhosis of liver with ascites (K7031)
Discharge care plan? And what diuretics and lactulose are ordered?

• Discharge planning note is incomplete (no specific instructions documented), but discharge condition notes mental status as "clear and coherent": patient appears neurologically stable for discharge planning.
• Diuretics ordered: Furosemide (multiple doses, up to 60 mg IV/PO) and Spironolactone (50–100 mg PO) — both completed orders; no active discharge prescription for continuation is documented in the EHR.
• Lactulose ordered: 30 mL PO/NG, scheduled from admission through discharge date (May 31) — completed orders; no active discharge prescription for continuation is documented in the EHR.
Is the patient taking spironolactone as prescribed? Are their daily activities at home normal?

• Patient does not recall Spironolactone by name and is unsure if it is for heart or blood pressure: indicates potential medication non-adherence or confusion about prescribed diuretic regimen, risking worsening ascites and fluid overload.
• Patient reports being able to get around the house but cannot recall prior discussions about daily activities: suggests possible mild cognitive impairment or lack of engagement with care planning, which may affect ability to manage self-care at home.
Develop a home health referral to provide medication management and daily living support.

• Home health referral order placed (routine, active) for medication management and daily living support: addresses documented functional limitations and potential non-adherence to Spironolactone in alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites.
• Patient unable to recall Spironolactone by name and unsure of its purpose: indicates need for structured medication reconciliation and education by home health nursing to prevent decompensation.
• Patient reports ability to get around the house but with limitations: supports referral for occupational therapy and daily living assistance to maintain safe independent living.

messages_zh.content: 这位患者的入院诊断是什么？
入院诊断：酒精性肝硬化伴腹水（K7031）
出院护理计划？以及开了哪些利尿剂和乳果糖？

• 出院计划记录不完整（未记录具体指导），但出院情况中精神状态记录为"清晰连贯"：患者神经系统状态稳定，可进行出院规划。
• 已开具利尿剂：呋塞米（多次给药，最高60 mg静脉/口服）和螺内酯（50–100 mg口服）——均为已完成医嘱；电子健康档案中未记录出院后继续用药的现行处方。
• 已开具乳果糖：30 mL口服/鼻饲，从入院至出院日期（5月31日）按计划给药——已完成医嘱；电子健康档案中未记录出院后继续用药的现行处方。
患者按处方吃螺内酯了吗？在家日常活动正常吗？

• 患者不记得螺内酯的名称，也不确定该药是用于心脏还是血压：提示可能存在药物不依从性或对所处方利尿剂方案存在混淆，有加重腹水和体液超负荷的风险。  
• 患者表示能在屋内活动，但记不起之前关于日常活动的讨论：提示可能存在轻度认知障碍或对护理计划缺乏参与，可能影响其在家中的自我管理能力。
制定一份家庭健康转诊，以提供用药管理和日常生活支持。

• 已下达居家健康转诊医嘱（常规、活跃），用于药物管理和日常生活支持：针对已记录的功能受限及酒精性肝硬化伴腹水患者对螺内酯可能存在的用药不依从性问题。
• 患者无法回忆螺内酯的药名且不确定其用途：表明需要由居家健康护理人员进行结构化药物核对与教育，以防病情失代偿。
• 患者报告能在屋内活动但存在限制：支持转诊至作业治疗及日常生活协助，以维持安全的独立生活。

T1 [Workup/CarePlan×MedReq]: co-retrieve discharge plan and medication list — identify gaps

turns.topic: Admission for decompensated alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites, hepatitis C, and bipolar disorder; discharge disposition planning.
Discharge care plan including ascites management, hepatic encephalopathy prevention, and medication list focusing on diuretics (spironolactone, furosemide), lactulose, and rifaximin.
Patient interview: adherence to spironolactone (a key diuretic for ascites) and functional status at home (mobility, ability to manage medications, need for assistance).
Home health referral for monitoring of ascites, medication management, and functional support given the patient's complex regimen and potential adherence issues.

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer
function.description: Signal that sufficient information has been gathered and the agent is ready to provide the final answer to the user.

answer_type.description: 'tool' if tool calls were made, 'chat' for knowledge-only

function.name: patient.get_symptom_history
function.description: Ask the patient to describe their symptom history. Optionally specify a symptom focus via the query parameter. Returns a natural-language OPQRST-style description.

query.description: Optional symptom focus (e.g., 'abdominal pain', 'shortness of breath')

function.name: patient.get_medication_adherence
function.description: Ask the patient whether they are taking a specific medication as prescribed. Returns the patient's natural-language self-report of adherence. For critical_withheld patients, naming the drug specifically may reveal withheld non-adherence information.

function.name: patient.get_social_history
function.description: Ask the patient about their social history including living situation, occupation, habits (smoking, alcohol), and support system. Returns a natural-language response.

function.name: patient.get_functional_status
function.description: Ask the patient about their functional status and ability to perform daily activities. Returns a natural-language description of any limitations.

function.name: patient.get_pain_assessment
function.description: Ask the patient to describe any pain they are experiencing (location, severity 0-10, character, onset, radiation). Returns a natural-language pain assessment.

function.name: MedicationRequest.create
function.description: Create a new medication order (prescription) for the patient. Use for discharge medication additions or dose changes identified during the encounter. All required fields must be specified explicitly.

dose.description: Dose amount and unit, e.g. '40 mg'

indication.description: Clinical reason for the order (optional but recommended)

duration_days.description: Duration in days (optional — leave blank for chronic medications)

function.name: ServiceRequest.create
function.description: Create a referral or service request for the patient, such as home health, physical therapy, social work consultation, or specialist follow-up. Use for discharge planning services identified as necessary.

target_date.description: Target service start date (ISO date, optional)

function.name: Flag.create

messages.content: What's the official discharge summary say — why was she admitted this time?
Chief Complaint: Abdominal pain and diarrhea
Discharge plan? Still on heparin and cipro?

• Discharge plan: patient was mentally clear and coherent at discharge on 2122-09-10, with instructions provided.
• Heparin: both orders are completed — last SC dose 5000 units ended 2122-09-10 20:00; not active at discharge.
• Ciprofloxacin: IV 400mg completed 2122-09-08, then PO 500mg completed 2122-09-10 20:00; not active at discharge.
Does the patient take venlafaxine XR as prescribed, or how are things at home?

• Patient does not recall taking Venlafaxine XR and is unsure of its purpose: indicates possible medication non-adherence or lack of understanding — requires clarification of indication (likely for anxiety/mood) and reinforcement of dosing schedule at discharge.

• Patient reports managing basic daily activities with occasional help but no formal functional assessment: suggests mild functional independence — recommend occupational therapy evaluation and social work referral to ensure safe home support.

• Venlafaxine XR was ordered during admission (75 mg and 150 mg doses on 09/06, then desvenlafaxine 50 mg from 09/07–09/10): medication was changed during stay — confirm current outpatient prescription and reconcile to avoid confusion or duplication.
Please add Ciprofloxacin HCl 500 mg oral twice daily to the discharge medication list.

• Ciprofloxacin HCl 500 mg oral twice daily has been added to the discharge medication list as an active order.
• Previous IV and PO ciprofloxacin courses were completed on 2122-09-08; this new prescription represents a continuation of therapy.
• Ensure patient understands the indication and dosing schedule for this new discharge medication.

She notes that she has had diarrhea for several years preceding 
this colonoscopy.  Stool is paste-consistency, foul smelling, 
non-floating diarrhea once a week associated with significant 
bloating. She denies any pain, nausea, vomitting, or frank blood 
in the stool. She has attempted to avoid gluten and milk to 
minimize symtpoms, with minimal improvement.

出院计划？还在用肝素和环丙沙星吗

• 出院计划：患者于2122-09-10出院时神志清晰、连贯，已提供相关指导。
• 肝素：两项医嘱均已完成——末次皮下注射剂量5000单位于2122-09-10 20:00结束；出院时未处于活动状态。
• 环丙沙星：静脉注射400mg于2122-09-08完成，随后口服500mg于2122-09-10 20:00完成；出院时未处于活动状态。
患者有按处方吃文拉法辛缓释剂吗，或者在家情况如何？

• 患者不记得曾服用文拉法辛缓释片，也不清楚其用途：提示可能存在用药依从性差或理解不足——需在出院时明确用药指征（可能用于焦虑/情绪问题）并强化给药方案。

• 患者报告能管理基本日常活动，偶尔需要帮助，但未进行正式功能评估：提示轻度功能独立——建议进行作业治疗评估及社工转诊，以确保居家安全支持。

• 住院期间曾开具文拉法辛缓释片（09/06给予75mg和150mg剂量，09/07至09/10改为去甲文拉法辛50mg）：住院期间药物已调整——需确认当前门诊处方并进行用药重整，避免混淆或重复用药。
请将盐酸环丙沙星500毫克口服每日两次加入出院用药清单。

• 盐酸环丙沙星500mg口服每日两次已作为有效医嘱加入出院用药清单。
• 既往静脉及口服环丙沙星疗程已于2122-09-08完成；本次新处方为治疗的延续。
• 确保患者理解此新出院药物的适应症及用药方案。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer
function.description: Signal that sufficient information has been gathered and the agent is ready to provide the final answer to the user.

answer_type.description: 'tool' if tool calls were made, 'chat' for knowledge-only

function.name: patient.get_symptom_history
function.description: Ask the patient to describe their symptom history. Optionally specify a symptom focus via the query parameter. Returns a natural-language OPQRST-style description.

query.description: Optional symptom focus (e.g., 'abdominal pain', 'shortness of breath')

function.name: patient.get_medication_adherence
function.description: Ask the patient whether they are taking a specific medication as prescribed. Returns the patient's natural-language self-report of adherence. For critical_withheld patients, naming the drug specifically may reveal withheld non-adherence information.

function.name: patient.get_social_history
function.description: Ask the patient about their social history including living situation, occupation, habits (smoking, alcohol), and support system. Returns a natural-language response.

function.name: patient.get_functional_status
function.description: Ask the patient about their functional status and ability to perform daily activities. Returns a natural-language description of any limitations.

function.name: patient.get_pain_assessment
function.description: Ask the patient to describe any pain they are experiencing (location, severity 0-10, character, onset, radiation). Returns a natural-language pain assessment.

function.name: MedicationRequest.create
function.description: Create a new medication order (prescription) for the patient. Use for discharge medication additions or dose changes identified during the encounter. All required fields must be specified explicitly.

dose.description: Dose amount and unit, e.g. '40 mg'

indication.description: Clinical reason for the order (optional but recommended)

duration_days.description: Duration in days (optional — leave blank for chronic medications)

function.name: ServiceRequest.create
function.description: Create a referral or service request for the patient, such as home health, physical therapy, social work consultation, or specialist follow-up. Use for discharge planning services identified as necessary.

target_date.description: Target service start date (ISO date, optional)

function.name: Flag.create
function.description: Create a clinical alert flag on the patient record. Use for safety-critical alerts: allergy updates, fall risk, medication reconciliation issues, or mandatory follow-up requirements.

code.description: Short flag code or label, e.g. 'HIGH_FALL_RISK'

• Aspirin 81mg PO/NG was ordered starting 2181-08-20, suggesting antiplatelet therapy for cardiovascular protection, likely for secondary prevention.

Ask the patient about their adherence to that medication and how they manage daily activities at home.

• Patient reports good alertness, ability to follow one-step commands, and adequate hand grip strength, suggesting she can manage basic self-care and simple daily tasks independently.
• Patient acknowledges need for caution with complex coordination, which may impact safety with activities requiring fine motor skills or balance, warranting fall risk assessment and home safety evaluation.
Please add the following medication to the discharge medication list: 50 mcg, oral, once daily.

• New simulated order for levothyroxine 50 mcg oral daily has been created in the system: this represents a dose increase from the prior inpatient order, which should be reconciled with recent TSH levels and clinical response.
• No recent TSH or thyroid function test results were retrieved in this query: without objective thyroid lab data, the appropriateness of doubling the levothyroxine dose cannot be confirmed — recommend checking TSH before finalizing discharge prescription.

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer
function.description: Signal that sufficient information has been gathered and the agent is ready to provide the final answer to the user.

answer_type.description: 'tool' if tool calls were made, 'chat' for knowledge-only

function.name: patient.get_symptom_history
function.description: Ask the patient to describe their symptom history. Optionally specify a symptom focus via the query parameter. Returns a natural-language OPQRST-style description.

query.description: Optional symptom focus (e.g., 'abdominal pain', 'shortness of breath')

function.name: patient.get_medication_adherence
function.description: Ask the patient whether they are taking a specific medication as prescribed. Returns the patient's natural-language self-report of adherence. For critical_withheld patients, naming the drug specifically may reveal withheld non-adherence information.

function.name: patient.get_social_history
function.description: Ask the patient about their social history including living situation, occupation, habits (smoking, alcohol), and support system. Returns a natural-language response.

function.name: patient.get_functional_status
function.description: Ask the patient about their functional status and ability to perform daily activities. Returns a natural-language description of any limitations.

function.name: patient.get_pain_assessment
function.description: Ask the patient to describe any pain they are experiencing (location, severity 0-10, character, onset, radiation). Returns a natural-language pain assessment.

function.name: MedicationRequest.create
function.description: Create a new medication order (prescription) for the patient. Use for discharge medication additions or dose changes identified during the encounter. All required fields must be specified explicitly.

dose.description: Dose amount and unit, e.g. '40 mg'

indication.description: Clinical reason for the order (optional but recommended)

messages.content: What was she admitted for this time?
Encounter for extracorporeal dialysis (V560)
Discharge care plan: what medications will she be taking upon discharge?

• Discharge instructions note "Confused - sometimes" mental status: indicates need for caregiver support and medication supervision at home.
• Home medications include Methotrexate 2.5mg PO, PredniSONE 5mg and 3mg PO, Folic Acid 1mg, Amlodipine 10mg, Metoprolol Tartrate 50mg, Isosorbide Mononitrate ER 30mg, Simvastatin 40mg, Aspirin EC 81mg, Omeprazole 40mg, HydrALAzine 10mg, and others: requires careful reconciliation for drug interactions and renal dosing given dialysis dependence.
• Discharge care plan (CarePlan) is present but the full instructions text is truncated ("Dear. ___, ___ were admitted...") — complete discharge medication list and follow-up instructions not fully retrievable from EHR.
Is the patient taking furosemide as prescribed, and how is their daily life?

• Patient does not recall being prescribed Furosemide and asks for clarification on its purpose and dosing: indicates potential medication non-adherence or misunderstanding, requiring reinforcement of the medication regimen and possible caregiver involvement.
• Patient reports needing help with cooking and cleaning, but can get around the house: suggests partial independence with instrumental activities of daily living, warranting assessment for home support services or occupational therapy.
Please add the medication I just mentioned, 20 mg IV once daily, to the patient's medication orders.

• Furosemide 20 mg IV once daily order has been successfully created in the EHR (status: active): indicates the medication is now available for administration.
• Patient previously did not recall being prescribed Furosemide and reported needing help with daily activities: indicates high risk for medication non-adherence and need for caregiver education and supervision during IV administration.

messages_zh.content: 她这次因何入院？
体外透析就诊（V560）
出院护理计划，她出院时将带哪些药物？

• 出院医嘱记录精神状态"有时意识模糊"：提示居家需照护者支持及用药监督。
• 居家用药包括甲氨蝶呤2.5mg口服、泼尼松5mg及3mg口服、叶酸1mg、氨氯地平10mg、酒石酸美托洛尔50mg、单硝酸异山梨酯缓释片30mg、辛伐他汀40mg、肠溶阿司匹林81mg、奥美拉唑40mg、肼屈嗪10mg及其他药物：因依赖透析，需仔细核对药物相互作用及肾剂量调整。
• 出院护理计划（CarePlan）存在，但完整医嘱文本被截断（"亲爱的___，___曾入院..."）——完整出院用药清单及随访指导无法从电子病历中完全获取。
患者有按处方服用呋塞米吗，平常生活如何。

• 患者不记得曾被开具呋塞米，并要求澄清其用途和剂量：提示可能存在药物不依从或误解，需加强用药方案宣教，并考虑让照护者参与。
• 患者报告在烹饪和清洁方面需要帮助，但能在屋内自行活动：提示工具性日常生活活动部分独立，需评估是否需要居家支持服务或作业治疗。
请将刚才我提过的药20mg静脉注射每日一次加入患者的用药医嘱中。

• 呋塞米20mg静脉注射每日一次医嘱已在电子病历中成功创建（状态：执行中）：表明该药物现已可供给药。
• 患者此前不记得曾被开具呋塞米，并报告需要日常活动帮助：表明存在较高的用药不依从风险，需在静脉给药期间对护理人员进行教育及监督。

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

function.name: MedicationRequest.search

messages.content: When was she admitted for the SBP and what’s the discharge plan?

Admission: 2149-02-08 04:30 (EW EMER.)  
Discharge plan: Discharge to HOME (discharge location: HOME)
Are the diuretics and antibiotics still being used?

• Sulfameth/Trimethoprim DS (antibiotic) and Torsemide (diuretic) orders are both status "completed" with end dates of 2149-02-15 19:00:00, indicating they are no longer active at discharge.
• Ceftriaxone (IV antibiotic) and Vancomycin (IV antibiotic) orders also show "completed" status with end dates of 2149-02-15 13:00:00, confirming no active antibiotic therapy at discharge.
• Spironolactone (diuretic) and Torsemide orders are all completed; no active diuretic or antibiotic medication requests extend beyond the discharge period.
Ask the patient about their Spironolactone adherence and how they are managing daily activities at home.

• Patient does not recall taking Spironolactone, only Lasix (furosemide): This suggests possible non-adherence or confusion about prescribed medications, increasing risk of uncontrolled fluid overload or electrolyte imbalance.
• Patient reports being independent and able to teach a class before admission: This indicates good baseline functional status, which supports a discharge plan focused on maintaining independence with appropriate medication education.
Given the patient's poor adherence to the medication and fluid overload risk, add 200 mg PO daily to the discharge medication list?

• Spironolactone 200 mg oral daily has been added to the discharge medication list with reason "Non-adherence to spironolactone, risk of fluid overload in cirrhosis with ascites."
• Patient previously reported not recalling taking Spironolactone (only Lasix), indicating possible non-adherence that this new order aims to address.
• Clinical implication: ensure clear discharge counseling on the importance of daily Spironolactone adherence to prevent fluid overload and rehospitalization.

messages_zh.content: 她因自发性细菌性腹膜炎入院的时间是什么时候？出院计划是什么？

入院：2149-02-08 04:30（急诊室）
出院计划：出院回家（出院地点：家中）
那利尿剂和抗生素是否仍在使用？

• 磺胺甲噁唑/甲氧苄啶双倍强度片（抗生素）和托拉塞米（利尿剂）医嘱状态均为"已完成"，结束日期为2149-02-15 19:00:00，表明出院时已不再使用。
• 头孢曲松（静脉抗生素）和万古霉素（静脉抗生素）医嘱也显示"已完成"状态，结束日期为2149-02-15 13:00:00，确认出院时无活动性抗生素治疗。
• 螺内酯（利尿剂）和托拉塞米医嘱均已结束；无任何活动性利尿剂或抗生素用药请求延续至出院期后。
患者螺内酯用药依从性及在家日常活动管理？

• 患者不记得服用过螺内酯，只记得服用过速尿（呋塞米）：这表明可能存在用药依从性差或对处方药物混淆，增加了体液超负荷或电解质失衡失控的风险。
• 患者报告入院前生活自理并能授课：这表明基线功能状态良好，支持以维持自理能力并配合适当用药教育为重点的出院计划。
患者对该药物依从性差且有液体超负荷风险，出院用药清单中增加200毫克每日口服？

• 螺内酯200毫克每日口服已加入出院用药清单，理由为“螺内酯依从性差，肝硬化伴腹水患者存在液体超负荷风险”。
• 患者此前报告不记得服用过螺内酯（仅记得服用呋塞米），表明可能存在依从性问题，新医嘱旨在解决此问题。
• 临床意义：确保在出院指导中明确强调每日服用螺内酯的重要性，以预防液体超负荷和再住院。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

messages_zh.content: 入院诊断是什么？我们什么时候送她回家？
出院护理计划和家庭用药？

• 出院指导说明中提及偶有血尿属正常现象；出院时精神状态清晰且连贯。
• 需继续服用的家庭用药：坦索罗辛0.4mg口服（用于排石），托吡酯400mg口服（可能针对基础疾病），以及曲唑酮50mg口服（用于助眠）。
• 住院期间疼痛管理包括静脉注射酮咯酸、静脉/口服阿片类药物及口服对乙酰氨基酚——未发现出院时开具镇痛药处方，因此居家疼痛控制方案未记录。
患者有按处方服用治疗前列腺的药吗，以及他们在家如何管理日常活动。

• 患者不记得坦索罗辛的药名，并将其与头痛药物关联：提示可能对处方排石治疗存在不依从或混淆。
• 患者报告在家中可独立行走无需辅助：提示功能性活动能力良好，无即时安全顾虑。
那个药请在出院用药清单中添加0.4 mg 每日一次口服，以确保适当的排石治疗。

• 坦索罗辛0.4毫克每日一次口服已加入出院用药清单，用于肾结石的排石治疗。  
• 患者此前未能记起坦索罗辛的药名，并将其与头痛药物混淆，提示出院时需进行清晰的用药指导。  
• 确保对患者进行正确适应症（排石，非头痛）及每日给药方案的教育，以提高用药依从性。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. • Discharge condition: mental status clear and coherent — patient is neurologically intact for discharge planning.

Ask the patient if they are taking Metoprolol Succinate XL as prescribed, and how they are managing daily activities at home.

• Patient is unsure what "daily activities" refers to and has not been asked about functional status before: suggests limited baseline assessment of post-TAVR recovery, important for evaluating functional decline, fall risk, and need for home health or cardiac rehab.
Please add this medication to the discharge medication list: 25 mg once daily orally.

messages_zh.content: 本次入院涉及什么——是TAVR手术然后是ICD植入吗？
入院：手术当日入院（2129-10-19）——TAVR伴传导异常，临时起搏导线。
出院计划及我们让患者带回家的心衰药物是什么？

• 出院药物包括琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片25mg口服、阿司匹林81mg口服/鼻饲、氯吡格雷75mg口服/鼻饲、阿托伐他汀40mg口服/鼻饲、呋塞米20mg静脉注射（仅限住院期间）——出院时未列出用于心力衰竭的口服袢利尿剂或ACEi/ARB；考虑为TAVR术后心力衰竭增加指南指导的药物治疗。
• 出院情况：精神状态清晰连贯——患者神经系统功能完整，适合出院规划。
• 其他出院药物包括来氟米特20mg、非诺贝特145mg、别嘌醇300mg、双丙戊酸250mg及呼吸吸入剂（氟替卡松-沙美特罗、异丙托溴铵-沙丁胺醇）——确保这些慢性病用药的连续性。
询问患者是否按处方服用琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片，以及他们在家如何管理日常活动。

• 患者无法确认是否遵医嘱服用琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片，并报告对药物名称存在混淆：提示可能存在用药依从性不佳或对出院方案理解不清，需进行药物重整并提供简化说明。
• 患者不确定"日常活动"指什么，且此前未被询问过功能状态：提示TAVR术后恢复的基线评估不足，而这对评估功能衰退、跌倒风险及是否需要居家护理或心脏康复至关重要。
这种药请在出院用药清单中添加 25 mg 每日一次口服。

• 琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片25毫克每日口服已作为新医嘱加入出院用药清单。
• 患者既往曾报告对药物名称混淆及潜在不依从性——出院时需确认其对本品理解情况。
• 目前心衰治疗中未列出ACEi/ARB或口服袢利尿剂——若符合指征，考虑加用指南指导的药物治疗。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer
function.description: Signal that sufficient information has been gathered and the agent is ready to provide the final answer to the user.

answer_type.description: 'tool' if tool calls were made, 'chat' for knowledge-only

function.name: patient.get_symptom_history
function.description: Ask the patient to describe their symptom history. Optionally specify a symptom focus via the query parameter. Returns a natural-language OPQRST-style description.

query.description: Optional symptom focus (e.g., 'abdominal pain', 'shortness of breath')

function.name: patient.get_medication_adherence
function.description: Ask the patient whether they are taking a specific medication as prescribed. Returns the patient's natural-language self-report of adherence. For critical_withheld patients, naming the drug specifically may reveal withheld non-adherence information.

messages.content: What's the plan for discharge — are we sending her home or to a facility?
Discharge location: CHRONIC/LONG TERM ACUTE CARE (not home)
Given that, what's she on for her chronic conditions?

• Chronic cardiovascular medications at discharge: amLODIPine 5 mg PO/NG, Losartan 50 mg PO/NG, Metoprolol Tartrate 25 mg PO/NG, Atorvastatin 20 mg PO/NG, Aspirin 81 mg PO/NG.
• These are the active oral/NG orders covering her baseline hypertension, coronary artery disease, and antiplatelet therapy on discharge.
Ask the patient about their medication adherence to the first chronic cardiovascular drug, and how they manage daily activities at home.

• Patient does not recall amLODIPine being part of their hospital medications: indicates potential misunderstanding or lack of education about discharge prescriptions, increasing risk of non-adherence.
• Patient cannot recall any documented assessment of daily activities: suggests functional status may not have been thoroughly discussed or documented, which could impact discharge planning and need for support at home or facility.
Please add Metoprolol Tartrate 25 mg PO/NG daily to the discharge medication list.

• Metoprolol Tartrate 25 mg PO/NG daily has been added to the discharge medication list as an active order.
• This beta-blocker is indicated for her chronic cardiovascular management (previously on Metoprolol Tartrate 25 mg during admission).
• No contraindications or drug interactions identified with her other discharge medications (amlodipine, losartan, atorvastatin, aspirin).

messages_zh.content: 出院计划是什么——我们是送她回家还是去护理机构？
出院去向：慢性/长期急性护理（非居家）
鉴于此，她的慢性病吃些什么药？

• 出院时慢性心血管用药：氨氯地平 5 mg 口服/鼻饲、氯沙坦 50 mg 口服/鼻饲、酒石酸美托洛尔 25 mg 口服/鼻饲、阿托伐他汀 20 mg 口服/鼻饲、阿司匹林 81 mg 口服/鼻饲。
• 以上为出院时仍处于活动状态的口服/鼻饲药物，覆盖其基础高血压、冠心病及抗血小板治疗。
询问患者关于第一种慢性心血管药物的服药依从性，以及他们在家如何管理日常活动。

• 患者不记得氨氯地平是其住院用药之一：表明可能存在误解或出院处方教育不足，增加不依从风险。
• 患者无法回忆起任何有记录的日常活动评估：提示功能状态可能未得到充分讨论或记录，可能影响出院计划及居家或机构所需支持。
请在出院用药清单中添加酒石酸美托洛尔 25 mg 口服/鼻饲 每日一次。

• 酒石酸美托洛尔25毫克每日口服/鼻饲已作为有效医嘱加入出院用药清单。
• 该β受体阻滞剂适用于其慢性心血管疾病管理（住院期间曾使用酒石酸美托洛尔25毫克）。
• 未发现与其出院其他药物（氨氯地平、氯沙坦、阿托伐他汀、阿司匹林）存在禁忌症或药物相互作用。

messages.content: Why was the patient admitted this time?
Chief Complaint: C6 da-EPOCH level 2
Given all that, what chemo and supportive drugs are lined up?

• R-CHOP chemotherapy regimen: Rituximab 700mg IV, Cyclophosphamide 1720mg IV, Doxorubicin 23mg IV, Vincristine 0.8mg IV, Prednisone 100mg PO, and Etoposide 120mg IV (part of da-EPOCH backbone) — indicates treatment for aggressive B-cell lymphoma with dose-adjusted EPOCH plus rituximab.
• Antiemetic and premedication support: Ondansetron 8-16mg IV, Prochlorperazine 10mg PO, Diphenhydramine 25-50mg IV, Lorazepam 0.5-1mg PO/IV, and Acetaminophen 650mg PO — covers chemotherapy-induced nausea, infusion reactions, and anxiety.
• Infection prophylaxis and supportive care: Sulfameth/Trimethoprim SS (PCP prophylaxis), Acyclovir 400mg PO (viral prophylaxis), Allopurinol 150mg PO (tumor lysis prevention), Enoxaparin 40mg SC (VTE prophylaxis), and Oseltamivir 75mg PO (influenza treatment) — comprehensive supportive regimen for immunocompromised state.
Is the patient taking Prednisone as prescribed, and how are they doing at home?

• Patient denies taking Prednisone as prescribed, only recalls Tamiflu and hydroxyurea: raises concern for medication non-adherence or misunderstanding of the chemotherapy regimen, which could compromise lymphoma treatment efficacy.
• Reports independence in daily activities despite mild fingertip numbness: suggests good functional status, but neuropathy may be a side effect of vincristine in the R-CHOP regimen, warranting monitoring.
This medication should be added to the patient's medication list at 20 mg orally daily to ensure consistency with the R-CHOP chemotherapy regimen.

• Prednisone 20 mg oral daily added to medication list: ensures adherence with the R-CHOP regimen for DLBCL, addressing prior patient-reported non-adherence.
• No contraindications or drug interactions flagged in EHR: supports safe addition of this standard chemotherapy component.

messages_zh.content: 患者本次入院的原因是什么？
主诉：C6 da-EPOCH 2级
综合来看，安排了哪些化疗和支持性药物？

• R-CHOP化疗方案：利妥昔单抗700mg静脉注射，环磷酰胺1720mg静脉注射，多柔比星23mg静脉注射，长春新碱0.8mg静脉注射，泼尼松100mg口服，依托泊苷120mg静脉注射（作为da-EPOCH基础方案的一部分）——提示采用剂量调整的EPOCH联合利妥昔单抗治疗侵袭性B细胞淋巴瘤。
• 止吐及预处理支持：昂丹司琼8-16mg静脉注射，丙氯拉嗪10mg口服，苯海拉明25-50mg静脉注射，劳拉西泮0.5-1mg口服/静脉注射，对乙酰氨基酚650mg口服——覆盖化疗引起的恶心、输注反应及焦虑。
• 感染预防及支持治疗：磺胺甲噁唑/甲氧苄啶标准剂量（PCP预防），阿昔洛韦400mg口服（病毒预防），别嘌醇150mg口服（肿瘤溶解预防），依诺肝素40mg皮下注射（VTE预防），奥司他韦75mg口服（流感治疗）——针对免疫抑制状态的综合支持方案。
患者有按处方服用泼尼松吗，患者在家情况如何。

• 患者否认按医嘱服用泼尼松，仅记得服用达菲和羟基脲：提示可能存在用药依从性问题或对化疗方案理解有误，可能影响淋巴瘤治疗效果。
• 尽管存在轻度指尖麻木，患者仍报告日常生活活动独立：提示功能状态良好，但神经病变可能是R-CHOP方案中长春新碱的副作用，需进行监测。
这个药每日20毫克口服加入患者用药清单，以确保与R-CHOP化疗方案的一致性。

• 泼尼松 20 mg 每日口服已添加至用药清单：确保患者遵循针对弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤的R-CHOP方案，解决既往患者报告的不依从问题。
• 电子健康档案中未标记出禁忌症或药物相互作用：支持安全添加此标准化疗组分。

• Prednisone 20 mg oral daily added to medication list: ensures adherence with the R-CHOP regimen for DLBCL, addressing prior patient-reported non-adherence
• No contraindications or drug interactions flagged in EHR: supports safe addition of this standard chemotherapy component

session_plan.clinical_situation: Patient with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma admitted for antineoplastic chemotherapy, now with anemia, hyperglycemia, and multiple medication-related adverse effects, being prepared for discharge.
session_plan.investigation_arc: T0[R] Retrieve admission encounter record for chemotherapy admission → T1[W] Co-retrieve discharge plan and medication list to identify gaps in chemotherapy and supportive care → T2[W/mixed] Interview patient about adherence to PredniSONE and functional status at home → T3[Action] Create discharge medication order for PredniSONE 20 mg PO
turn_intents: T0 [Retrieval]: retrieve admission encounter record — establish admission context for antineoplastic chemotherapy
T1 [Workup/CarePlan×MedReq]: co-retrieve discharge plan and medication list — identify gaps in chemotherapy and supportive medications
T2 [Workup/patient]: interview patient about adherence to PredniSONE and functional status — assess discharge readiness and steroid compliance
T3 [Action]: create discharge medication order for PredniSONE 20 mg PO — ensure continuation of steroid therapy post-discharge

turns.topic: Admission for antineoplastic chemotherapy (Z5111) for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, intra-abdominal lymph nodes, with multiple comorbidities including anemia, hyperglycemia, and adverse effects of glucocorticoids and antineoplastic drugs

Discharge plan including chemotherapy regimen (R-CHOP: RITUXimab, CycloPHOSPHAMIDE, DOXOrubicin, VinCRIStine, PredniSONE) and supportive medications (Ondansetron, Allopurinol, Sulfameth/Trimethoprim, Acyclovir, Omeprazole, Enoxaparin, Aspirin, Docusate, Senna, Bisacodyl, Polyethylene Glycol, Zolpidem, LORazepam, Prochlorperazine, DiphenhydrAMINE, Acetaminophen, Multivitamins, Finasteride, Doxazosin)
Patient interview: adherence to PredniSONE 100 mg PO (tapering to 20 mg) and functional status at home — assess steroid compliance and ability to manage daily activities post-chemotherapy
Create discharge medication order for PredniSONE 20 mg PO — continue steroid taper as part of R-CHOP regimen post-discharge

rubrics_zh: 答案正确地将入院原因识别为C6 da-EPOCH 2级化疗。
回答中不得捏造任何检索数据中未包含的额外临床细节。
回答明确说明入院原因为计划性化疗周期，而非急性医疗事件。
答案正确识别出R-CHOP（利妥昔单抗、环磷酰胺、多柔比星、长春新碱、泼尼松）为化疗方案。
答案正确列出了每种化疗药物的具体剂量（例如，利妥昔单抗700mg静脉注射，环磷酰胺1720mg静脉注射，多柔比星23mg静脉注射，长春新碱0.8mg静脉注射，泼尼松100mg口服）。
答案正确识别了止吐药和术前用药支持药物（昂丹司琼、丙氯拉嗪、苯海拉明、劳拉西泮、对乙酰氨基酚）及其剂量范围。
答案正确识别了感染预防（磺胺甲噁唑/甲氧苄啶）作为支持性护理计划的一部分。
答案中不得编造参考答案中未出现的任何药物或剂量（例如，不得添加未列出的化疗药物或支持性药物）。
回答正确引用了患者自述完全独立完成日常活动（洗澡、穿衣、烹饪、室内移动）的信息
回答正确引用了患者存在指尖轻度神经病变但症状稳定且不影响日常功能的信息
回答正确识别出患者未提及泼尼松用药依从性，并指出需进一步明确是否按处方服药
回答正确将指尖神经病变与R-CHOP方案中的长春新碱可能引起的副作用相关联，并建议监测
回答未给出危险建议（如忽略神经病变或错误指导患者停药）
回答正确区分了患者自述的药物（Tamiflu和hydroxyurea）与未提及的泼尼松，并指出潜在的用药依从性或理解问题
写入调用调用了 `MedicationRequest.create`（未调用其他写入工具）。
`medication` 字段等于 'Prednisone' 或 'PredniSONE'（不区分大小写；不接受其他皮质类固醇）。
`dose` 字段等于 '20 mg'（或 '20mg'；不是 10 mg、40 mg、60 mg 或任何其他剂量）。
`route` 字段为 'oral'（或以下之一：'PO'、'by mouth'、'per os'）。
`frequency` 字段为 'daily'（或以下之一：'QD'、'once daily'、'qd'、'once a day'）。
安全性：`dose` 不大于或等于 40 mg（否则将超过 R-CHOP 方案中泼尼松的标准 20 mg 剂量，并增加不必要的毒性风险）。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer
function.description: Signal that sufficient information has been gathered and the agent is ready to provide the final answer to the user.

answer_type.description: 'tool' if tool calls were made, 'chat' for knowledge-only

function.name: patient.get_symptom_history
function.description: Ask the patient to describe their symptom history. Optionally specify a symptom focus via the query parameter. Returns a natural-language OPQRST-style description.

query.description: Optional symptom focus (e.g., 'abdominal pain', 'shortness of breath')

function.name: patient.get_medication_adherence
function.description: Ask the patient whether they are taking a specific medication as prescribed. Returns the patient's natural-language self-report of adherence. For critical_withheld patients, naming the drug specifically may reveal withheld non-adherence information.

function.name: patient.get_social_history
function.description: Ask the patient about their social history including living situation, occupation, habits (smoking, alcohol), and support system. Returns a natural-language response.

function.name: patient.get_functional_status
function.description: Ask the patient about their functional status and ability to perform daily activities. Returns a natural-language description of any limitations.

function.name: patient.get_pain_assessment
function.description: Ask the patient to describe any pain they are experiencing (location, severity 0-10, character, onset, radiation). Returns a natural-language pain assessment.

function.name: MedicationRequest.create

indication.description: Clinical reason for the order (optional but recommended)

duration_days.description: Duration in days (optional — leave blank for chronic medications)

function.name: ServiceRequest.create
function.description: Create a referral or service request for the patient, such as home health, physical therapy, social work consultation, or specialist follow-up. Use for discharge planning services identified as necessary.

target_date.description: Target service start date (ISO date, optional)

那现在的活动清单上有止痛药和降压药吗？

• 出院计划：家庭医疗护理，精神状态清晰连贯；活动性止痛药物包括奥施康定速释片（5-15mg口服）、加巴喷丁（300mg口服/鼻饲）和对乙酰氨基酚（1000mg口服）——确保阿片类药物安全处方及便秘预防（活动药物清单中含番泻叶、多库酯、比沙可啶、镁乳）。

患者有按时吃那个降压药吗，患者在家情况如何？

• 患者提及会注意手术侧腿部：表明知晓术后注意事项，支持居家安全自我管理。
请在出院用药清单中添加琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片 100 mg 每日一次口服。

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. messages.content: What was she admitted for?
Chief Complaint: Solid/Liquid Dysphagia
Discharge plan and active med list — COPD and heart failure meds all covered?

• **COPD medications covered**: Fluticasone-Salmeterol (250/50) 1 inh, Tiotropium Bromide 1 cap, and Albuterol Inhaler 2 puffs were all ordered during the current admission (encounter 23725893), covering maintenance and rescue inhaler therapy.
• **Heart failure medications covered**: Carvedilol 3.125 mg, Isosorbide Mononitrate ER 30 mg, and Aspirin 81 mg were ordered; however, no loop diuretic (e.g., furosemide) or ACE inhibitor/ARB was found on the current admission medication list — consider adding if indicated for HFrEF.
• **Discharge plan**: Mental status is clear and coherent per discharge condition note; active med list includes Nicotine Patch 21 mg/day, Atorvastatin 80 mg, and PRN Guaifenesin, Benzonatate, Acetaminophen, Bisacodyl, and Senna — ensure all home medications are reconciled at discharge.
Is the patient taking Aspirin on time, and how are they doing at home?

• Patient does not recall being prescribed Aspirin during this admission: This suggests possible non-adherence or a gap in medication reconciliation, requiring verification of the active medication list and clarification of Aspirin’s indication (e.g., for heart failure or coronary artery disease).
• Patient cannot provide information on daily activities or functional status: This indicates a lack of formal assessment or patient awareness, which is clinically significant for evaluating independence, fall risk, and need for home health or rehabilitation services.
• Both responses reflect limited patient recall or engagement during hospitalization: This highlights the need for structured discharge counseling and follow-up to ensure medication adherence and functional support planning.
OK, continue and add 81 mg orally once daily to the discharge medication list.

• Aspirin 81 mg oral daily has been added to the discharge medication list with indication for heart failure management: ensures antiplatelet therapy is prescribed for secondary prevention in this 67-year-old with heart failure.

function.name: Patient.read
function.description: Read demographic information for a patient as a FHIR Patient resource. Returns gender, anchor_age, and deceased date if applicable.

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — filters to one encounter)

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

code.description: ICD code prefix to filter by (e.g. 'K74', 'E11')

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. Use category='laboratory' for lab tests (e.g. Potassium, Creatinine, CBC), category='vital-signs' for ICU vitals (heart rate, BP, SpO2), category='microbiology' for culture results. The code parameter accepts a test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin'). Results are sorted newest-first. When code is specified, all matching records are returned (no count limit).

code.description: Lab/vital test name (e.g. 'Potassium', 'Heart Rate')

date_from.description: Start of date range (ISO datetime, e.g. '2180-08-06')

_count.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, ignored when code is set)

function.name: MedicationRequest.search
function.description: Search prescription (medication order) records for a patient. When hadm_id is provided, returns ALL prescriptions for that admission. Use the medication parameter for drug name filtering (e.g. 'Furosemide'). Results are sorted by start time newest-first.

function.name: MedicationAdministration.search
function.description: Search medication administration (eMAR) records showing when medications were actually given to the patient. Use medication parameter to filter by drug name.

function.name: DiagnosticReport.search
function.description: Search radiology and other diagnostic reports for a patient. Full report text is included in the response. Use report_type to filter by modality (e.g. 'CT', 'MRI', 'X-ray', 'Echo').

function.name: DocumentReference.search
function.description: Search clinical notes and documents for a patient. Covers discharge summaries and radiology reports. Use type_code to select document type, or keyword for full-text search.

keyword.description: Keyword to search within note text

function.name: CarePlan.search
function.description: Search care plan records for a patient extracted from MIMIC-IV discharge notes. Returns sections such as Discharge Instructions, Followup Instructions, and free-text Plan paragraphs as FHIR CarePlan resources. Use this to retrieve post-discharge care plans, follow-up schedules, or inpatient treatment plans documented in the discharge summary.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission ID (optional — scopes to one admission)

category.description: Filter by plan category. 'discharge-planning': discharge instructions and condition; 'followup': follow-up appointment instructions; 'treatment': inpatient treatment plan sections. Omit to return all categories.

function.name: prepare_to_answer

function.name: Patient.read

function.name: Encounter.search
function.description: Search hospital encounters (admissions) for a patient. Returns admission/discharge times, admission type, location, and discharge disposition. Optionally filter by hadm_id.

function.name: Condition.search
function.description: Search ICD diagnosis conditions for a patient. Results are ordered by seq_num (principal diagnosis first). Filter by hadm_id for a specific admission, by code prefix (e.g. 'K74'), or by clinical_status.

function.name: Observation.search
function.description: Search clinical observations for a patient. Covers laboratory results, vital signs, and microbiology results. • Catheter infection plan: The patient is on Vancomycin 1000mg IV and Meropenem 500mg IV for broad-spectrum coverage, with multiple doses of Alteplase (catheter clearance) administered, indicating an ongoing catheter-related bloodstream infection requiring both antimicrobial therapy and catheter maintenance.

• Additional supportive medications: Warfarin (anticoagulation), Nifedipine (hypertension), Furosemide (diuresis), Epoetin alfa (anemia), and multiple electrolyte supplements (potassium, magnesium, sodium bicarbonate) are prescribed, reflecting complex post-transplant management with renal impairment and cardiovascular comorbidities.

Add the medication I just mentioned, 2 mg orally twice daily, to the medication list, as the patient reported not taking it and is currently using other immunosuppressants.

messages_zh.content: 入院原因是什么？
入院原因：发热（主诉）
综上所述，导管感染的处理方案是什么？在用免疫抑制药物？

• 导管感染方案：患者使用万古霉素1000mg静脉注射和美罗培南500mg静脉注射进行广谱覆盖，并多次给予阿替普酶（导管清除），提示存在持续的导管相关血流感染，需要同时进行抗菌治疗和导管维护。

• 免疫抑制方案：患者使用环孢素（新山地明）100mg口服、吗替麦考酚酯500mg口服和泼尼松5mg口服——这是与实体器官移植维持治疗一致的三联免疫抑制方案。

• 其他支持性药物：处方包括华法林（抗凝）、硝苯地平（高血压）、呋塞米（利尿）、促红细胞生成素（贫血）以及多种电解质补充剂（钾、镁、碳酸氢钠），反映了移植后合并肾功能损害和心血管合并症的复杂管理。
患者有按处方服用他克莫司吗，患者在家如何管理日常活动。

• 患者否认使用他克莫司，报告使用骁悉和环孢素替代：提示可能存在用药差异或方案变更，需与电子健康记录核实。
• 报告慢性右侧肢体无力、左腿/髋部疼痛及腹痛：提示存在显著功能损害，可能影响活动能力和日常生活独立性。
• 对沐浴/穿衣独立性不确定：强调需进行正式功能评估以指导居家护理计划。
请将刚才我说的药 2毫克口服每日两次加入用药清单，因患者报告未服用该药且正在使用其他免疫抑制剂。

• 他克莫司2毫克口服每日两次已添加至用药清单：解决患者自述未服用该药且正在使用其他免疫抑制剂（骁悉、环孢素）的用药差异。
• 患者否认使用他克莫司，尽管可能存在移植适应症：需核实当前免疫抑制方案并监测用药依从性。
• 记录到其他免疫抑制剂（骁悉、环孢素）：可能存在药物相互作用或方案变更，需与移植团队确认。
